title: Polarised Square Sunglasses with UV400 Lenses, Unisex
description:
Classic square sunglasses with polarised lenses that cut glare from water, roads and snow. A lightweight everyday pair that suits most face shapes.
• Frame: matte polycarbonate with spring hinges, total width 142 mm, lens height 45 mm
• Lenses: polarised TAC, UV400 protection, filter category 3
• Weight: 26 g
• Includes a soft pouch and microfibre cleaning cloth

title: Retro Round Metal Sunglasses, Gold-Tone Frame, UV400
description:
Round wire-frame sunglasses with a 1970s feel and a slim gold-tone metal frame. Adjustable nose pads keep them comfortable all day.
• Frame: alloy metal, lens diameter 50 mm, bridge 21 mm
• Lenses: tinted, UV400 protection, filter category 3
• Adjustable silicone nose pads
• Includes a drawstring pouch

title: Oversized Square Sunglasses for Women, Gradient Lenses
description:
Bold oversized sunglasses with soft gradient lenses and a chunky frame. The large lenses give generous coverage on bright days.
• Frame: lightweight polycarbonate, total width 148 mm, lens height 55 mm
• Lenses: gradient tint, UV400 protection, filter category 2
• Frame weight: 32 g
• Includes a hard clamshell case

title: Cotton Baseball Cap with Adjustable Strap, Unisex
description:
A classic six-panel cap in washed cotton twill with a pre-curved peak. The adjustable back strap fits most adult head sizes.
• Material: 100% cotton twill with a cotton sweatband
• Fits head circumference 55–61 cm
• Pre-curved 7 cm peak and embroidered air holes
• Metal slide buckle at the back

title: Ribbed Knit Beanie with Turn-Up Cuff, Unisex
description:
A soft, stretchy rib-knit beanie that keeps ears warm on cold mornings. Wear it slouchy or with the cuff turned up.
• Material: 100% acrylic soft-touch yarn
• One size, stretches to fit 54–60 cm
• Length 30 cm unfolded with a double-layer cuff
• Machine washable at 30 °C

title: Wide-Brim Woven Straw Sun Hat with Ribbon Band
description:
A breezy woven sun hat with a wide brim for beach days, gardens and city breaks. The inner drawstring lets you fine-tune the fit.
• Material: paper straw with a polyester ribbon band
• Brim width 9 cm, fits 56–58 cm with the inner adjuster
• Packable: the brim springs back into shape after folding
• Weight: 120 g

title: Soft Brushed Winter Scarf, Extra Long 180 cm
description:
A warm, generously sized scarf with a soft brushed finish that wraps twice around the neck. Short fringed ends add a classic touch.
• Material: 100% acrylic, brushed on both sides
• Size: 180 × 30 cm plus 8 cm fringe
• Machine washable at 30 °C
• Weight: 180 g

title: Lightweight Printed Square Scarf, 90 × 90 cm
description:
A silky-smooth printed scarf that works as a neck scarf, head wrap or bag accent. Light enough for spring and summer outfits.
• Material: 100% polyester satin with neatly rolled edges
• Size: 90 × 90 cm
• Wear it as a neckerchief, headband or tied to a bag handle
• Hand wash cold, cool iron

title: Men's Leather Belt with Brushed Pin Buckle, 35 mm
description:
A dependable everyday belt cut from split cowhide leather and finished with a brushed pin buckle. Works with jeans and chinos alike.
• Material: split cowhide leather, zinc alloy buckle
• Width 35 mm, thickness 3.5 mm
• Five adjustment holes spaced 2.5 cm apart
• Length is measured from the buckle to the middle hole

title: Women's Slim Faux Leather Belt with Gold-Tone Buckle
description:
A slim belt for cinching dresses, cardigans and high-waisted trousers. The polished gold-tone buckle adds a neat finishing detail.
• Material: PU faux leather, zinc alloy buckle
• Width 20 mm, total length 105 cm with 7 holes
• Fits waist sizes 68–90 cm
• Weight: 90 g

title: Touchscreen Knit Gloves with Fleece Lining
description:
Warm knitted gloves with conductive fingertips on the thumb, index and middle finger, so you can use your phone without taking them off. Ribbed cuffs keep the cold out.
• Material: 95% acrylic, 5% elastane with a brushed fleece lining
• Conductive pads on three fingertips, work with most smartphones and tablets
• Silicone grip dots on the palm
• One size fits most adult hands

title: Sherpa-Lined Cable Knit Gloves for Winter
description:
Chunky cable-knit gloves with a plush sherpa lining for the coldest days. A long ribbed cuff tucks neatly under coat sleeves.
• Outer: 100% acrylic cable knit; lining: polyester sherpa
• Length 24 cm including a 7 cm cuff
• One size, fits palm widths up to 9.5 cm
• Machine washable at 30 °C in a laundry bag

title: Satin Scrunchies Set of 6, Soft Hair Ties
description:
Smooth satin scrunchies that hold ponytails and buns with less pulling than ordinary elastic ties. A mixed set of six colours to match any outfit.
• Material: polyester satin over covered elastic
• Diameter approx. 10 cm when relaxed
• Set of 6 assorted colours
• Suitable for fine, thick and curly hair

title: Polished Metal Hair Clips, Set of 3 Sizes
description:
Polished metal hair clips with a strong spring hinge for half-up styles, twists and low buns. Minimal shapes that look smart from desk to dinner.
• Material: zinc alloy with a plated finish and steel spring
• Sizes: 9 cm, 7 cm and 5 cm
• Firm grip for medium to thick hair
• Supplied in a reusable organza bag

title: Bobby Pins 120 Pieces with Storage Tin
description:
Everyday hair grips with a wavy side for extra hold and rounded tips that slide in gently. The flip-top tin keeps them together in a bag or drawer.
• 120 pins, 5 cm long, steel with a matte coating
• Rounded protective tips
• Wavy top side for a secure grip
• Includes a reusable metal storage tin

title: Men's Leather Bifold Wallet with RFID Blocking Lining
description:
A slim bifold wallet in smooth leather with an RFID-blocking lining that helps shield contactless cards. Plenty of room for cards and notes without the bulk.
• Material: cowhide leather exterior, RFID-blocking polyester lining
• 8 card slots, 2 note compartments and 1 ID window
• Closed size: 11.5 × 9.5 × 1.5 cm
• Gift box included

title: Slim Leather Card Holder with 6 Card Slots
description:
A pocket-friendly card holder for days when you only need the essentials. Three slots on each side plus a centre pocket for folded notes.
• Material: genuine leather with stitched edges
• 6 card slots and 1 centre pocket, holds up to 10 cards
• Size: 10.5 × 7.5 × 0.6 cm
• Weight: 30 g

title: Plush Bunny Bag Charm Keychain with Checked Skirt
description:
A fluffy bunny charm in a little checked skirt that adds a playful touch to bags, keys and backpacks. The lobster clasp clips on and off in seconds.
• Material: polyester plush, cotton-blend skirt, alloy clasp and ring
• Size: approx. 12 cm tall (charm only)
• Lobster clasp plus split key ring
• Decorative accessory, not a toy

title: Stainless Steel Heart Keyring with Polished Finish
description:
A sleek heart-shaped keyring cut from stainless steel that resists rust and tarnish in daily use. A small, thoughtful gift for partners and friends.
• Material: 304 stainless steel, polished finish
• Heart size: 3.2 × 3 cm; split ring diameter 25 mm
• Short chain link between heart and ring
• Comes in a velvet gift pouch

title: Men's Paisley Tie Set with Pocket Square and Cufflinks
description:
A coordinated three-piece set for weddings, interviews and office days: a woven paisley tie, a matching pocket square and polished cufflinks. Presented in a gift box, ready to give.
• Tie: polyester microfibre jacquard, 148 × 8 cm
• Pocket square: 23 × 23 cm
• Cufflinks: silver-tone alloy with bullet-back closure
• Gift box size: 25 × 12 × 4 cm
